title: createStory
description: Creates a new story or issue in the tracker. Returns the stable ID and browser URL of the created issue.

labels.description: Zero or more label strings. Must be values from supported_labels, or any string if supported_labels is null.

parent_id.description: Parent issue ID. Adapters with hierarchy 'flat' MUST silently ignore this field.

team_value.description: Runtime value for the team/workspace (field identified by capabilities.metadata.team_field)

project_value.description: Runtime value for the project/board (field identified by capabilities.metadata.project_field)

id.description: Stable tracker-assigned identifier for the new story

url.description: Browser-navigable URL to the created issue
